verdict.rationale: Customer.io's docs describe a primary OpenAPI spec covering the Track, App, and Design Studio APIs at the conventional path. A probe confirmed https://docs.customer.io/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. A Postman collection is also offered. Missing for 10: no evidence the downloadable spec covers the Pipelines (CDP) API, which the docs call the API most users will use.
